about.description: Transport Alarm watches live arrival times for the stops and routes you choose, and alerts you a set number of minutes before your bus arrives.
about.disclaimer: Arrival times come from the transport operators and can be late, missing or wrong. Transport Alarm is not affiliated with any of them.
about.source.hk.title: Hong Kong
about.source.hk.body: Timetables from the Transport Department, and live arrivals from KMB and Citybus, provided through DATA.GOV.HK.
about.source.bods.title: Great Britain
about.source.bods.body: Bus timetables and live locations from the Bus Open Data Service, Department for Transport. Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
about.source.tfl.title: London
about.source.tfl.body: Powered by TfL Open Data. Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database rights 2016 and Geomni UK Map data © and database rights [2019].
